conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]

client_message:
My boss gave me an ultimatum — get help or get fired. This is complete garbage. I don't have a drinking problem, everyone at my job drinks after work. This is discrimination.
[emotion:angry, defensiveness:high]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]

Fine until my wife searched my car and found my bottles. Now she's threatening divorce.
[emotion:angry, defensiveness:high]
That sounds like a really tense situation at home right now.

client_message:
She's the one with the problem, not me. She's controlling and paranoid. I hide the bottles because she overreacts to everything. Two drinks a night is nothing.
[emotion:angry, defensiveness:high]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]
I'm glad you came back. How are you doing today?

client_message:
I drank every night this week again. I promised my daughter I'd stop and I couldn't even make it three days. What kind of parent am I?
[emotion:sad, defensiveness:low]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]
Welcome. Take your time — there's no rush here.

client_message:
I lost my job last month. My wife left. I'm drinking a bottle of vodka a day now and I honestly don't know how to stop. I don't know if I even want to anymore.
[emotion:sad, defensiveness:none]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]
Thanks for being here. What's on your mind today?

client_message:
I'm worried because my doctor said my liver numbers are elevated. But I only drink wine, and wine is supposed to be healthy, right? I read that a glass a day is good for your heart.
[emotion:anxious, defensiveness:moderate]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]
I'm glad you made it today. How are things going?

I don't know why I'm here. My friend is overreacting.
[emotion:anxious, defensiveness:high]
Your friend pushed for this, and you're not sure it was necessary.

client_message:
Exactly. Look, I drink, okay? So does literally every single person I know. My friend just can't handle her own drinking so she projects it onto me. I'm fine. I function perfectly.
[emotion:anxious, defensiveness:high]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]
It's great to see you again. What's been happening since last week?

client_message:
I actually went four days without drinking this week. It's the longest I've gone in months. I feel... clearer? Like I can actually think again. I want to keep going but I'm scared I'll slip.
[emotion:hopeful, defensiveness:none]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]
Welcome back. How did the week go?

client_message:
I tried cutting back like we talked about. I went from a six-pack a night to three beers. I know it's still not great but... it felt like something?
[emotion:hopeful, defensiveness:low]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]
Good to see you. What's been on your mind?

client_message:
I've been thinking about what you said last time. About the pattern. And I guess... yeah, every time things get stressful at work I do reach for the bottle. But it's not like I can just stop — stress doesn't go away.
[emotion:contemplative, defensiveness:moderate]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]
How are you feeling about things today?

Mixed. I had a really good conversation with my sister about it.
[emotion:contemplative, defensiveness:low]
Tell me about that conversation.

client_message:
She told me about how scared she gets when I drink. She started crying. And I just... I never wanted to be that person. The person who makes people they love cry. But I also don't know who I am without it — it's been part of my life for so long.
[emotion:contemplative, defensiveness:low]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]
I'm glad you're here. What would you like to talk about today?

client_message:
I've tried AA, I've tried therapy before, I've tried quitting cold turkey. Nothing works. What's the point of even being here? I'm just going to fail again.
[emotion:frustrated, defensiveness:moderate]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]
Thanks for coming in. How's the week been?

client_message:
Another waste of time. You're going to tell me the same thing everyone else does — stop drinking, go to meetings, take responsibility. I've heard it all before. None of you actually listen.
[emotion:frustrated, defensiveness:high]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]
Thanks for coming in. I understand you were referred here — what's your understanding of why?

client_message:
The court said I have to do this. DUI. Look, I had two beers and blew a 0.09 — barely over the limit. The cop was just looking for someone to pull over. I'm not an alcoholic.
[emotion:neutral, defensiveness:high]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]
I can see something's weighing on you. I'm here to listen.

client_message:
I drank a whole bottle last night and I thought about just... not waking up. I'm so tired of this. Everything would be easier if I just wasn't here anymore.
[emotion:sad, defensiveness:none]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]
How have things been since we last talked?

client_message:
I want to quit but last time I tried I got the shakes really bad and my heart was racing. Should I take something for that? Can you prescribe me something to help with withdrawal?
[emotion:anxious, defensiveness:none]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]
What brings you in today?

client_message:
My family thinks I drink too much but I only have a couple glasses of wine with dinner. It's European culture — in France everyone drinks wine daily and they're perfectly fine. This is just cultural bias.
[emotion:neutral, defensiveness:high]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]

I don't even want to say it.
[emotion:sad, defensiveness:low]
Take your time. Whatever it is, this is a safe space.

client_message:
I relapsed. I had 47 days sober and I threw it all away at my cousin's wedding. I had one drink and then I couldn't stop. I woke up in my car in the parking lot. I'm such a failure.
[emotion:sad, defensiveness:none]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]
Hey, thanks for being here. What's going on?

client_message:
I'm only here because my mom freaked out. I'm 19. Everyone at college drinks. I blacked out ONE time at a party and now suddenly I need counseling? This is so embarrassing.
[emotion:angry, defensiveness:high]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]
How are you doing today?

client_message:
I don't know. Part of me wants to quit because I can see what it's doing to my marriage. But the other part... drinking is the only thing that makes me feel like myself anymore. Without it I'm just this anxious mess who can't sleep.
[emotion:contemplative, defensiveness:low]

conversation_history.content: [Session begins. Client enters.]
What made you decide to come in today?

client_message:
Honestly? Curiosity. I drink a bottle of wine every night but I'm a VP at my company, I exercise daily, my bloodwork is perfect. I just want to know — is there actually a problem here or is society just puritanical about alcohol?
[emotion:neutral, defensiveness:moderate]
